add.event: 海地借款偿还原贷款最后部分，最大受益银行为Crédit Industriel et Commercial
add.evidence: Haiti had to take a loan in 1875 to pay back the final portion of the original loan, and the bank that benefited most from this was Crédit Industriel et Commercial.

add.event: 剩余债务的最后一笔款项付清
add.evidence: in 1838 France agreed to reduce the remaining debt to 60 million to be paid over 30 years, with the final payment paid in 1883.

add.event: 海地才向纽约国民城市银行付清全部相关利息
add.evidence: it took until 1947 for Haiti to finally pay off all the associated interest to the National City Bank of New York (now Citibank).

add.event: 法国议会废除查理十世1825年敕令，但未提供赔偿
add.evidence: In 2016, the Parliament of France repealed the 1825 ordinance of Charles X, though no reparations have been offered by France.
